[u]What are special orders and the order board ?[/u]
A new feature in 1.5. If you want to keep surprise about this part, i suggest to read the description of the mod later since it will contains spoiler

[u]What is the content of this mod ?[/u]
There are several quests, divided in different categories. Each category is focused on a theme. Categories are currently : AnimalRancher, Cook, Farmer, Fighter, Fisher, Florist, Forager, Generic, Miner. Some categories will involve different perks and will not always be restricted to their main domain, but it gives you quests revolving about it.

A config option allows to disable categories you don't want to see. Just remove the category for the listed ones. Example, if you don't want animal focused tasks and fighting tasks you can have : Cook, Farmer, Fisher, Florist, Forager, Generic, Miner as your option.

[u]When i will see the quests ?/I use the mod but the quests are vanilla, why ?[/u]
Since vanilla quests are important for a new feature, these quests are designed to only show after you did at least one related vanilla quest. This will give you higher chance of seeing the vanilla quests (in addition to the game giving you higher chance to see new quests), and will make my quests appearing after you did at least some parts of the vanilla content, avoiding being overwhelmed and allowing you to get fresh content over time.

When possible, requirements will be something in the same domain than the quest theme. For example, you'll need to do a specific vanilla quest asking you to kill monsters before seeing the fighter quests.

[b]Important note :[/b]
If you want to remove a category in the config option, ensure that you don't have any related quests active or on the board, since this may cause issue.

[u]When do you suggest adding the mod ?[/u]
When you saw enough of the vanilla quests and want something fresh. I suggest experiencing vanilla content first !


Mod authors if you want to use this mod as example to make your own board quests : see [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/590]Can i use your mod as a template for making my own special orders ?[/url] If you still have questions please ask :)


This mod uses some JA items in optional quests (they will not appears if you don't have the mod).
One quest uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7110]Lumisteria Flowers and Crops[/url].
One quest uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1598/]PPJA Fruits and Veggies[/url] (with permission).

Other quests may accept modded items depending of what is required. For that, i use contexts tags. You can see some details about that in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/590]Can i use your mod as a template for making my own special orders ?[/url] article.



Since this mod is the first published about special orders there may be issues, let me know if you encounter any !
